question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.**

He was/ paid handsomely for/ his ability to handle/ the crowd skillful.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The grammatical error is in the phrase **"the crowd skillful." **
 
• The adjective** "skillful"** is used incorrectly**.** It should be replaced with the adverb "**skillfully**" to modify the verb "handle<
